notes: Unified workflows preserve managed batch arrays, historical date arrays and per-stage interpolation arrays. Named jobs advance after successful scheduler and scientific verification. Initialization, registration and NRT use individual allocations.

history_start.description: Inclusive beginning of the consecutive historical input/state sequence.

start.description: Inclusive target start. Initial historical requests begin October 1.

stop.description: Inclusive final output date. Equal start and stop select one day; a WY ends September 30.

available_through.description: Inclusive input availability; final issues require seven look-ahead days.

shape.description: Actual native [rows, columns]; do not assume the generic example's shape.

stripe_rows.description: Positive processing stripe height; part of checkpoint layout.

tiles.description: Complete donor domain; each value follows interpolation_tile.

scheduler.description: See interpolation_scheduler; all base fields required.

asset_provenance.description: Versioned scientific evidence. Arbitrary descriptive metadata permitted; observation_policy is used for compatibility/NRT handoff.

seed.description: Controller-selected compatible checkpoint for every tile; absent for initial historical run.

seed_plan.description: Original historical plan provenance for current-format state; never a compatibility bypass or a legacy-algorithm selector.

stream_root.description: Controller-assigned stream root during incremental operation.

output_issues.description: Select exported NetCDF issues: all eight (0–7 future days), first/final (0/7), or final only (7). Every selected file contains all variables. Inherited by NRT cumulative tile/WY publication; donor eligibility, calculations and restart checkpoints are unchanged.

use_snow_climatology.description: Use monthly snow climatology for onset thresholds and the rare-snow veto. False fixes the frequency weight at one and bypasses that veto, retaining canopy rules and playa/bright-soil and agricultural thresholds/floors. Only JSON true/false are accepted. Applies to all issues; changing modes requires replay from history_start and compatible checkpoints.

notes: history_start <= start <= stop <= available_through; all calendar date bounds are inclusive.
Field paths resolve relative to request JSON; every calendar date must be present, with null only for a verified missing observation.
Controller-written state_context/state_identity are generated artifacts, not accepted initial request fields.
Earlier drafts used an exclusive stop: subtract one day from that stop and regenerate the plan to preserve the requested dates. Keep schema_version=1; other date fields do not change.

Planning records the resolved use_snow_climatology Boolean. Disabled requests discard frequency/coastal bindings before file inventory and header checks, leaving the source JSON unchanged. NRT inherits the mode; NetCDF attributes encode it as integer 0/1.

daily.description: Exactly all prepared_daily fields per nonmissing date, each mapped_field.

terrain.description: Exactly x, y, dem, slope, aspect, canopy_fraction, each mapped_field. Axes are projected metres; elevations integer metres; geometry degrees.

bright_soil.description: Annual bright-soil Boolean masks covering every observation WY, including replay prefix.

coastal.description: Explicit Boolean coastal mask controlling missing climatology treatment. Required when use_snow_climatology is true (the default); optional and ignored when false.

frequency.description: Exactly 12 monthly snow frequencies, January through December. Required when use_snow_climatology is true (the default); optional and ignored when false.

notes: With use_snow_climatology enabled, both frequency and coastal are required. When disabled, neither binding participates in input inventory, scientific compatibility or worker reads. Annual bright_soil and agriculture remain required in both modes. Initialization asset lists are independent; omit climatology assets there for a workflow without that product.

screening_conditions.description: Packed cloud/SWIR conditions; see algorithm documentation.

solar_azimuth.description: Solar azimuth in degrees clockwise from north.

stream_root.description: Registered real historical stream; do not invent an empty history.

science_python.description: Interpreter with coordinated science packages for snow retrieval; the cloud package is not required here.

cloud_python.description: Standalone cloud interpreter for both observation-matched preparation and cloud inference; no SPIReS packages required.

observation_policy.description: Must exactly match historical asset_provenance.observation_policy; cloud_model_sha256 must equal the manifest bytes' SHA256. Additional policy fields are scientific identity, not arbitrary runtime overrides.

tiles.description: Every tile in the registered domain; retain previous WY recipes for replacements.

seed_plan.description: Original historical-plan provenance for current scientific state; never a numerical compatibility bypass.

through.description: Required in a universal nrt job. Standalone cycle takes --through instead; a JSON value alone does not select its date.

retrieval_concurrency.description: Concurrent tile/date subprocesses after whole-domain cloud inference. Defaults to all nonmissing tiles. Each subprocess runs one inversion worker with numerical-library threads limited to one. Request at least this many CPUs per task; smaller allocations fail rather than silently serialize. A smaller explicit value permits queued tile retrievals. This applies to historical prepare_date as well as NRT.

retrieval_memory_gib.description: Alternative per-worker memory budget, not an RSS limit. Mutually exclusive with preparation_memory_gib. When neither is specified, defaults to 6 GiB per concurrent tile plus 2 GiB coordinator headroom. Cloud and subsequent interpolation may require more. Slurm memory/CPU checks use allocation environment variables when available; outside Slurm, the caller must enforce reservations.

preparation_memory_gib.description: Direct total allocation budget in GiB for one date's cloud preparation, concurrent retrievals and coordinator. No additional per-tile multiplication or headroom is added. Mutually exclusive with retrieval_memory_gib. Set the Slurm --mem request to this value or greater; JSON checks an existing allocation, it does not submit or resize jobs. The five-tile example uses 16. Later interpolation may need a separately sized allocation.

scheduler.description: Optional shared resource profile. Supplies preparation concurrency/memory defaults and archives resolved configuration; does not submit, resize an allocation or change the stream interpolation recipe.

notes: Run inside an allocation. Even without --execute, acquisition, matched clouds and retrieval run.
Use absolute deployed interpreter/model/recipe paths for standalone cycle. Universal workflow resolves recognized path fields relative to its/request JSON.
No automatic bootstrap, cron installation, schema migration or full-history replay.
With scheduler.job_type, preparation defaults come from the profile before explicit recipe overrides. Ensure the existing allocation also covers the registered interpolation settings.

lut.description: Reflectance LUT in evaluated band order I1/I2/I3/M2/M4/M8/M11.

preparation.description: Scene preparation options; see retrieval_preparation. Must use post_inversion clouds.

axes.description: x and y mapped_field bindings for the exact native grid.

ancillary.description: Mapped canopy_fraction, slope, aspect, ice_fraction required by retained retrieval.

background.description: baseline mapped_field with trailing band axis; optionally screened plus index as a pair.

source.description: Required by direct retrieve; filled from inventory by prepare_date.

clouds.description: Each value contains cloud and context GeoTIFF paths for the same-day domain; coordinator supplies it.

prepared_context.description: day_context digest for the complete same-day source inventory; coordinator supplies it.

notes: Source, clouds and prepared_context are mandatory when calling retrieve directly.
Solver 6, max_eval=200 and initial radius=250 micrometres are fixed by this worker; generic daily tuning fields are not accepted alternatives.

date.description: Must equal native source acquisition date.

fields.description: Required raw_snow_fraction, canopy_adjusted_fsca, screening_flags, qa_qf1, qa_qf7, sensor_zenith, grain_radius, dust, solar_zenith, solar_azimuth mapped fields; additionally exactly one of swir_flags or swir_score, or spectral reconstruction.

clouds.description: cloud/context paths, including available neighboring tiles.

spectral.description: Original spectral reconstruction evidence, see spectral_reconstruction.

output.description: Required by universal prepare jobs; standalone nrt prepare uses --output.

sse.description: Original spectral sum of squared errors; reconstructed fit must agree.

screened_background.description: Alternative original background, paired with screen_used.

screen_used.description: Boolean per-pixel alternative background selection, paired with screened_background.

bytes.description: File size from stat; not user-estimated.

source_stream.description: standard or nrt, derived from product.

prepared.description: Generated prepared_daily bindings on retrieval receipt.

notes: Create with source_record rather than hand-editing stat fields. Acquisition/archive controllers may attach additional provenance such as cmr_updated or origin; those are not deployment knobs.

unresolved_warning_days.description: Age at which unresolved NRT-to-standard dates warn.

growth_warning_bytes.description: Inventory growth warning threshold; 0 disables this warning.

archive_root.description: Durable archive; default STREAM_ROOT/archive. Cannot change in place once published. Must not overlap mutable workspaces.
Existing product input directory; files organized by tile/year.

script_root.description: Fresh output directory for coverage report and interactive download scripts.

notes: Standalone external acquisition utility, not a universal workflow job kind.
Default command only inspects local presence; --query writes scripts after CMR lookup, never downloads/submits.

See schemas.historical for every top-level field and scheduler option. Nested preparation is a recipe fragment, not a standalone nrt_cycle config: it has no config_type/schema_version header and uses science_python, cloud_python, cloud_model, collection, observation_policy, retrieval_concurrency, retrieval_memory_gib, preparation_memory_gib and tiles. stream_root, through and annual_bright_soil are not historical preparation options.

Tile/WY retrieval bindings follow interfaces.retrieval_recipe. terrain uses mapped_field bindings for dem (metres), slope and aspect (degrees). Daily albedo is evaluated only for state=2 and screening_flags=0; no interpolation is performed.

missing_reflectance defaults to error: missing local tile/dates stop planning. Explicit allow records each absent tile/date and search pattern in missing_sources, writes a null source inventory entry, and permits a missing-observation receipt. Receipt assembly verifies the saved plan and writes null daily mappings, expanded by interpolation into unknown state and NaN scientific fields. No fake reflectance or empty raster is written. These gaps remain null in NRT history and can be revisited. The planner does not query upstream availability; the operator authorizes local gaps. Duplicate vintages, corrupt existing files, inaccessible archive roots and sources lost or newly appearing after planning still fail. Start and stop dates are both inclusive (historical schema_version=1).
